premises.text: Existing braille computer interfaces are expensive ($5–8k) and limited to few words because of bulky piezoelectric technology, contributing to low literacy among blind children
premises.evidence_span: it's a $5,000 up to $8,000 keyboard. And where a blind person can read, it's extremely limited to just a few words

premises.text: Membrane-and-actuator airflow technology deforms each braille dot without mechanical elements, enabling thousands of dots on a tactile display
premises.evidence_span: We're using a high-performance membrane bonded to an electrical actuator so that through an airflow channel, we can control and deform each braille dot individually

premises.text: A tactile tablet with touch-screen voiceover control lets blind users learn, work, and play on one device reading a full page of braille
premises.evidence_span: It allows blind users for the first time to learn, work, and play with one single device

premises.text: Cloud Braille converter turns text, documents, and web pages into braille for the tablet
premises.evidence_span: It can convert anything into Brow, like text files, documents, even whole web pages

premises.text: Affordable ~$500 price with GTM via website, global distributors, and developing-country education channels
premises.evidence_span: with the affordable price of $500 US

value.text: Open literacy and digital access for blind users, especially children, via an affordable full-page tactile tablet
value.evidence_span: we can change the future of millions of children

secondary_value.text: Social mission to make schools and modern tech accessible for people with sight loss
secondary_value.evidence_span: We are a venture with social mission

causal_links.evidence_span: leads to low literacy rate among blind children
the digital e-reader for blind users
make BlightApp accessible to developing countries
we successfully scaled the technology and produced the world's first tactile display without any mechanical elements

notes: §4.1.6: cost, few-word limit, piezo tech, and literacy consequence folded as one interface-pain bundle (P1). Demo voiceover/e-book/1900-dot facets folded into tablet mechanism (P3). Price and multi-channel GTM kept one commercial premise (P5) per §4.1.3. Kenya request and 23 distributor agreements treated as traction evidence of P5, not separate premises.
